All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Activity
One entry of the recent-activity feed shown on the dashboard.
ActivityType
The kind of change recorded in the "recent activity" feed.
AppInfo
Central place for application-wide constants such as the name, tagline and version.
AppShell
The services the main window offers to the page controllers (dashboard, inventory, reports).
ConfirmDialog
Styled confirmation dialogs for destructive actions.
DashboardController
Controller of the dashboard page.
EmptyState
A friendly "nothing here yet" panel with an icon, a title, a short explanation and an optional button.
Icon
A small vector icon.
InventoryApplication
The JavaFX Application subclass.
InventoryController
Controller of the inventory page: the product table with search, status filter, edit, delete and refresh.
InventoryData
A plain snapshot of everything that must survive an application restart.
InventoryException
Base class of all checked, business-level errors raised by the inventory layer.
InventoryManager
The heart of the application: all inventory business logic lives here and nowhere else.
InventoryRepository
Abstraction of the permanent storage used by InventoryManager.
JsonInventoryRepository
Stores the inventory in a single human-readable JSON file.
Main
Application entry point.
MainController
Controller of the application shell: the sidebar, the top bar, page navigation and toast notifications.
Page
The screens that can be shown in the main content area.
PersistenceException
Thrown when inventory data cannot be loaded from or saved to permanent storage.
Product
A single product in the inventory.
ProductDialogController
Controller of the modal "Add Product" / "Edit Product" dialog.
ProductDialogController.Result
The outcome of a successful save.
ProductNotFoundException
Thrown when an operation refers to a product id that does not exist (any more), for example when updating or deleting a product that was already removed.
ReportsController
Controller of the reports page: a simple inventory summary with the share of products per stock status.
Resources
Finds the FXML views and the stylesheet that are packaged inside the application.
SimpleJson
A tiny JSON reader and writer so the project needs no external libraries.
StatusBadge
A small coloured "pill" showing a StockStatus: green for In Stock, amber for Low Stock and soft red for Out of Stock.
StockStatus
The stock level of a product.
TimeFormat
Turns timestamps into short, friendly text such as "5 min ago" or "Yesterday, 14:30".
ToastType
The visual style of a toast notification.
ValidationException
Thrown when user input is rejected, for example an empty name or a negative quantity.
ValidationException.Field
The input field a validation message belongs to.
